text:
Renee (People Ops): Quick update — timeline change from execs: the SOC2 + annual privacy evidence snapshot is now due Fri 04/01 17:00 PT (moved up 48 hrs). Need all primary artifacts in the uploader by then. See naming + exceptions below.

Marcus (Security): A note on priority  auditors asked for: access controls, vendor assessments for any vendor with customer data, and encryption key lifecycle proofs. Please surface those first.

Liu (Infra): For encryption, will a KMS rotation audit CSV + command used to export be sufficient?

Marcus (Security): Yes. Include the command and run timestamp in a README. If the CSV includes key IDs, redact any values and add a one-line note describing redactions. Filename example: `20260401_infra_kms_audit.csv`.

Gwen (Legal): Vendor questionnaires — procurement is triaging. If procurement can't produce signed questionnaires by the cutoff, will an official procurement email thread that includes vendor name, status, and expected date be accepted as interim evidence?

Marcus (Security): Provisional procurement emails are acceptable if they include owner and estimated completion. Mark them "provisional" in the uploader and follow up with the final doc within 7 business days.

Renee (People Ops): Naming convention (automation requires exact pattern):
```
<YYYYMMDD>_<team>_<control_shortname>.<ext>
examples:
20260401_eng_access_review.csv
20260401_legal_vendor_packet.pdf
20260401_infra_kms_audit.csv
```
Also add control id and owner email in the upload form. Uploader: https://go.redwood.company/evidence-upload-form

Vik (Data): For access reviews, can we provide CSV exports from our identity provider showing group membership with a query string + export timestamp?

Marcus (Security): Yes — CSVs are preferred. Include the query used to filter (one-liner) and the export timestamp. Example filename: `20260401_data_access_review.csv`.

Renee (People Ops): Office hours for the snapshot week: Thu 09:00-11:00 PT and Fri 13:00-16:30 PT. Calendar link: https://go.redwood.company/compliance-office-hours. Wefll have 15-minute slots for handholding.

Liu (Infra): Small question: does the ingestion script accept zipped bundles with directories per control, or must everything be flat?

Renee (People Ops): Flat zips only. Put files at the root and include README at root. Nested folders will cause auto-reject.

Gwen (Legal): Screenshots that show relative timestamps ("3 days ago") — acceptable?

Marcus (Security): No. Absolute timestamps required. If the UI only shows relative times, include the query/export plus the run timestamp in the README and a screenshot for context.

compliance_reminder_bot: Reminder set: "Snapshot evidence due Fri 04/01 17:00 PT". Will post in #people-ops and DM owners on the morning of the due date.

Vik (Data): I'll bundle data team artifacts and aim to upload Thu EOD.

Renee (People Ops): If you have contractors, sponsor sign-off required: sponsor must be a full-time Redwood employee and add a one-line attest in the upload form. No exceptions without sponsor.

Liu (Infra): Noted — infra will redact any secret values and include a redaction note.

Renee (People Ops): Two process reminders: 1) exact filenames are required for ingestion automation; mismatches will be auto-rejected and cause delays, 2) late uploads are accepted but become "exceptions" and increase review time. Please contact #compliance-help or DM me for urgent blockers. :pray:

Gwen (Legal): I'll open a procurement triage thread for the outstanding vendor packets.

Marcus (Security): Thanks all  reach out in this thread if anything ambiguous.
